title: Great experience traveling to the Granada airport
text:
Our travel agent scheduled our departure from Granada's Aurea Washington Irving Hotel to the Federico Garcia Lorca Granada-Jaen airport with Sun Travel Granada, and we're grateful that she did. Sun Travel Granada provided excellent service, beginning with Rafa arriving on time (early, actually) and transporting us in a very nice Mercedes. The ride was smooth and comfortable, and Rafa proved to be polite, engaging, and informative.

title: Excellent Service
text: Excellent Rafa Service, very attentive.  In the short time he transported us he told us of the culture and places of Granada that we should visit.  Excellent with our luggage and super friendly!!!
author: 578gilbertf

title: A Great Experience
text: Rafael was an amazing driver. He took the best care of me and I had a most wonderful experience with Sun Travel. The van was very clean, on the inside and out, and Rafael was very professional and a really nice guy overall. He was always on time and I never had to wait for him, and for my arrival flight into Granada he was waiting for me at the arrival door and walked me to the van before we drove back to Granada. I will definitely be using this service again for my future travels.
author: davisbw2

title: Rafael great driver
text: Rafael was very polite, friendly and attentive. We noticed one hour before going to the airport we forgot the camera at the rented car return. He agreed to pick us up 30min early and drive to the rental car office to look for it.

title: Greatest car service ever!
text: The service was impeccable. Great courtesy and consideration towards the customers. Rafael provided us with cold water, offering suggestions of highlights in Alhambra and Granada. Excellently clean car. Highly recommended.
